title: Days an Included Mileage Allowance Is Granted for on a Car Rental
content:
The days an included mileage allowance is granted for on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes are read off the rental's own ledger.

**The basis schedule.**

| What stands on the rental's ledger | The days the allowance is granted for |
|---|---|
| An extra day line | Every rental day and extra day charged on the ledger |
| No extra day line, and rental day lines for fewer days than the agreement books | The rental days actually charged |
| Anything else | Every booked rental day |

**The three bases told apart.** The first turns on an extra day line standing on the ledger, and where one stands the rental day lines and the extra day lines are counted together, whatever the agreement booked. The second applies only where no extra day line stands and the rental day lines run short of the days the agreement books; then the days actually charged govern. Where no extra day line stands and the rental day lines are as many as the agreement books, or more, the third basis governs and the booked rental days stand.

**Cases on hypothetical ledgers.**

*An agreement booking 5 rental days, its ledger carrying 5 rental day lines and 2 extra day lines.* An extra day line stands, so the allowance is granted for 7 days.

*An agreement booking 5 rental days, its ledger carrying 3 rental day lines and no extra day line.* The rental day lines run short of the days booked, so the allowance is granted for 3 days.

*An agreement booking 5 rental days, its ledger carrying 5 rental day lines and no extra day line.* Neither of the first two bases holds, so the allowance is granted for the 5 booked rental days.

*An agreement booking 5 rental days whose ledger carries no line at all and no extra day line.* No rental day line stands, which is fewer days than the agreement books, so the allowance is granted for no day.
